categories.main_business_segments: Jinlihua Electric Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: the manufacturing and sales of glass insulators for high-voltage, ultra-high-voltage, and extra-high-voltage power transmission lines, and the cultural media segment focusing on theatrical production and performance. The insulator business dominates revenue, accounting for over 86% of total sales in 2024, while the cultural segment involves stage play production, investment, and related cultural services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced manufacturing technologies including automated gluing production lines and German-imported molding equipment for glass insulators, achieving high automation and quality control. It holds multiple patents in glass insulator technology, including for AC/DC ultra-high-voltage insulators. The cultural segment relies on professional theatrical production teams and international collaborations for high-quality stage performances.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers for the glass insulator segment are major power grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, serving the electric power transmission infrastructure market domestically and expanding into emerging overseas markets in Asia, Africa, and Europe. The cultural segment serves theater audiences primarily in major Chinese cities and international venues, targeting high-education and high-consumption demographics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Shanxi and Zhejiang provinces. It also has growing international sales in Asia, Africa, and Europe. The cultural business is centered in Beijing with performances across major Chinese cities and international collaborations, including France.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinlihua Electric is positioned midstream in the electric power transmission supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of critical glass insulator components used in power grid infrastructure. It procures raw materials from qualified suppliers and produces semi-finished glass components internally. The cultural segment operates downstream, producing and presenting theatrical content directly to consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-voltage glass insulator technology, focusing on product reliability, automation, and energy efficiency. Key projects include development of lightweight, pollution-resistant, and high-strength glass insulators. It is also investing in digital smart factory upgrades and expanding international markets. The cultural segment emphasizes original theatrical productions and international artistic collaborations to enhance brand influence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of glass insulator products to power grid companies via bidding and contracts. The cultural segment earns revenue from ticket sales, performance fees, and related cultural product sales. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jinlihua Electric is among the leading domestic manufacturers of glass insulators with mature technology and the capability to produce ultra-high-voltage AC/DC insulators. It competes with a few other major players like Nanjing Electric and Sichuan Global. In the cultural sector, its subsidiary, Central China Times, is a leading private theatrical production company with strong market reputation and international partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 273 million, a 48.9% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by a 92.5% growth in the insulator segment. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose by 318.6% to RMB 32 million. The company has expanded production capacity significantly, with annual ultra-high-voltage glass insulator capacity increasing from 1 million to 4 million pieces. The cultural segment experienced a revenue decline due to reduced performance schedules.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinlihua Electric emphasizes its technological leadership in glass insulator manufacturing, including patented designs and automated production processes that improve quality and reduce costs. Its products are critical for the stability and safety of power grids, especially in ultra-high-voltage applications. The cultural segment differentiates through high-quality, original theatrical productions with strong artistic and market appeal, supported by international collaborations and a loyal, high-value audience base.
